data.title: IRGC: Three tankers hit mines, exploded while transiting Hormuz with US support | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: The statement to IRNA claimed that the tankers were being escorted and protected by the US military, but support "failed to prevent the incidents from occuring."
data.keywords: Iran,United States,blockade,Iranian Revolutionary Guards,Hormuz,IRGC,Strait of Hormuz,USA,CENTCOM
